# RentalSawari Pakistan

RentalSawari is a directory of verified rent-a-car companies in Pakistan.
Free for renters. Free basic listings for businesses. Direct WhatsApp contact, no booking fees, no commission.

## Coverage
- 1,085 verified rental companies across 8 cities
- Cities: Lahore, Islamabad, Karachi, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta
- Car categories: Economy (Mehran, Cultus), Sedan (Corolla, Civic), SUV (Fortuner, Prado), Luxury (Land Cruiser V8, Mercedes-Benz), Van (Hiace, APV, Bolan), Coaster (Toyota Coaster)
- Services: With Driver, Self-Drive, Airport Pickup, Wedding, Tourist Tours, Corporate Monthly, Northern Areas Tours, Luxury

## How RentalSawari is different
- Real per-day prices in PKR shown on every listing (most Pakistani competitors hide prices)
- WhatsApp links pre-filled with an introduction message
- Pakistani-context content: IDP rules for foreign visitors, NOCs for Gilgit-Baltistan, CNIC requirements, USD-denominated deposits
- Directory only: never holds bookings, deposits, or commissions
- Verification: every listing's CNIC and business address is confirmed before going live
- Featured listings cost PKR 5,000-12,000/month; basic listings are free forever
